rows.en: Defeat Locomotive Mask and all Zolder Soldiers!
<c3>Saburo Minami</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Saburo Minami</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
The giant computer "Brain", built for the sake of peace, reached the extreme conclusion that the greatest enemy of Earth's environment is humanity itself.
Brain vanished together with Professor Hustler, one of the staff who built it, formed the Brain Party, and began building giant robots to wipe out humanity.
A year later, the boy Saburo Minami, who had lost his sister and his parents in an attack by a Brain robot, followed that robot and wandered into the Brain Party's cave.
Pursued by Professor Hustler and his men, Saburo discovered a giant robot sleeping deep inside the cave, and awakened it…
Is this the robot?
Yes…
…!? Did you see this sphere too?
Yes. It was too bright to see clearly, but… it tried to kill me with a heat ray.
It's Brain… Brain used a heat ray!?
I've heard that in the laboratory attack a year ago, too, there were many victims of heat rays.
Father… hasn't Brain turned into a killing machine?
Hmm… That's not what I built it for…
By the way, Saburo, what's that helmet?
The robot gave it to me.

But… it's a strange story, isn't it?

When Saburo put on the helmet, the robot seemed to talk to him…

It's true! I'm not lying! But back then… I wonder what the robot said?

Oh well… The TDF science group is going to examine it closely, so we'll find out the helmet's secret too.

Mm… I intend to be present as well.

We've asked Chief Kitakura of the TDF's UCMA to come along too, partly as our escort…

Until our Red Muffler Squad, which took heavy damage in the attack, is rebuilt, I intend to formally join the TDF science group and repay my debt to them.

Leave it to me…

Guarding the facilities of each peace organization and protecting their staff is only natural for us in the UCMA Security Team.
I'm counting on you…
Yes, sir!

The one who blocks our path, Gel-Shocker's path to world conquest…

To defeat Kamen Rider, we must create even more powerful cyborgs!

To that end, steal the ultra-compact artificial brain invented by Dr. Yajima!! Go, Ganikomol!!
Giiih, giiiiih!!
There we go… Masaru, cocoa was okay for you, right?
Thank you…
I'm sorry, Mr. Tachibana. You're always looking out for my brother…

Nah, don't worry about it…

More importantly, what a shock… To think Dr. Komyoji's brain is inside Hakaider's head…
Damn DARK! Using such dirty tricks! They're just like the Neo-Human Empire…
Are you an android too, mister?
Hm? Why do you ask, Masaru?
You just kinda seem a lot like Jiro…
Hey, Masaru! That's rude to Goro, calling him an android…

It's all right.

Jiro and I are fighting for the same goal. When it comes to a heart that loves justice, there's no difference between a human and an android.

Besides… in the sense of being alone, Jiro and I are the same.
That's right… You were separated from your mother, your only family, 15 years ago, and you haven't seen her since.

Yes… I've searched long and hard…

No… Jiro was reunited with his brother! The day will surely come when I see my mother again too… That's what I believe.
Mm… Good for you, Goro! That's Goro Watari, that's [VAR6] for you!
What's wrong, sis…

Mm.

I started wondering how long we'll have to keep living like this, and suddenly…
Cut it out, that's pathetic! You're bigger than me and everything…

Sorry…

We're worrying about Father so hard, after all. We'll surely see him again, safe and sound, won't we?
Sure we will. And then even Jiro's Conscience Circuit will…

That's right… There are lots of dependable friends here!

Someday, for certain, we'll get the brain back from Hakaider, and Dr. Komyoji will make a full recovery. That's what everyone's fighting for!

And you're fighting splendidly at the TDF too, Mitsuko! The more new weapons you research and develop, the more they'll help everyone, guaranteed!

Now, don't worry too much. Head back to the TDF and go do your job with a smile.
Okay…
[HERO2]? What are you reading so intently?

Hm? Ah… An article about Giant Robo and Red Baron.

Every time they pull off something big, the mass media all rush to cover it.

"Boy and Robo Save Hostages!!" "Worst Averted at World Robot Expo!" it says…
Does it… bother you?
No way!? We're not fighting so people will fawn over us!
It's the Vol cells… isn't it?

That's right…

By taking in the Vol cells, our Roaring Steel should become a complete bio-weapon!

I believed, [HERO2], that you would be freed from Zephas's spell and awaken to your own self.

And that you would not spare your own life for the sake of justice…

Yeah…

I'll get the Vol cells no matter what, make the Roaring Steel a complete bio-weapon, and stop my father's scheme!
That said… it does bug me a little.
What does…?

This, this right here!

"Another Specialist Scientist Kidnapped!? Crisis Management Called into Question!!" "Evil Organizations Run Rampant! Japan Defenseless!" it says…

Unicorn and SSI, with their flashy giant robots, get all the cheers, while we in the Amigo Squad just keep getting bashed.

Fufufu… the Amigo Squad, is it…?

It's true. Rather than thinking of ourselves as the UCMA, a TDF support organization, we feel more like a group of friends gathered at the Amigo, don't we?

But… isn't it proof that Earth is still at peace? As long as it's only articles like this…
Well… I guess that's true.

Giant Robo and Red Baron… The two units are completely different, both in style and in how they're controlled, aren't they?

[HERO2], which one do you prefer?
Prefer? Hmm, let's see…
"Giant Robo, I guess?" "Red Baron, I'd say."
I like the remote-control part. I'm bad at piloting vehicles. And I never want to crash again!

Fufufu… That's true, isn't it?

To think you used to be a lieutenant and pilot in the TDF Air Force… I really can't believe it!

Starting with the fight against Gavan and then the atmospheric entry to this Earth, it was one failure after another, wasn't it?

All that's left, after all… is the remote-controlled command satellite.
Don't say another word! Just thinking about it makes me mad…
Wh-what!?

Giant robot appearing at 10 o'clock!

Affiliation: "Stateless" Attribute: "Unknown" [HERO2], it is not an allied robot.
The real thrill of a giant robot is piloting it! I'd rather move it myself, after all.
Just what I'd expect from a former TDF Air Force lieutenant and pilot! Fufufu…
What's so funny?

I'm sorry… But I thought you were hopeless at piloting, [HERO2]?

Starting with the fight against Gavan and then the atmospheric entry to this Earth, it was one failure after another…

The only thing that survived in one piece… is the remote-controlled command satellite.
Is it BF? Or the Iron Mask Party?
It can't be!? A new enemy…?

Anyway, let's get back to Dr. Yajima's lab!

Still… what is that robot attacking? What's in that spot?
[HERO2]? What are you so into… Ah, I get it! You're texting some girl, aren't you?

D-don't be stupid!

It's an article on a news site about Giant Robo and Red Baron.
Oh right… you switched to a phone with e-mode, didn't you? So, what does it say?

Yeah…

"Boy and Robo Save Hostages!!" "Worst Averted at World Robot Expo!" and all sorts of stuff.
Huh? What about us?

…Nothing.

Well, of course not, right? If people found out about us, the whole world would panic.
Why?
